{{Quote|No squeezie! No squeeze! No squeeze! Bad baby, oh he's a bad baby, yeah bad baby!!|The Anzellan after [[Din Grogu|Grogu]] tried to hug him|<ref name="Chapter 17" />}}
A [[Gender|male]] '''Anzellan droidsmith''' was a part of an [[Anzellan]] [[Anzellan Droidsmiths|crew]] and worked in a [[Droidsmith workshop|workshop]] on the [[Volcano|volcanic]] [[planet]] [[Nevarro]]. He tried to repair [[IG-11]] for [[Din Djarin]], but needed a new [[memory circuit]] to be able to continue the reparation. After explaining it to Djarin and him promising to find a new one, Grogu snuck up behind him and tried to take him. Djarin then took the Anzellan away from Grogu, only to try once more at taking him.<ref name="Chapter 17" />

After the pirate takeover of Nevarro, he and his crew can be seen hiding at their workshop while the pirates roam the streets. He and the other Anzellans were excited to see more Mandalorians helping clean the streets of the pirates.
